step_budget.note: initial L1 is the expectation of PyTorch default Linear init; observed growth approximates Adam's step-size ceiling

method.floor: Zero test MAE - bound; valid for any prediction |p| <= bound by E|y-p| >= E|y| - E|p|
method.limit: bounds are exact given the weights; they do not require running the GRU and do not replace prediction-level checks
